serverInfo.title: GotCashback
serverInfo.description: GotCashback is a cashback comparison service, not a cashback portal: it compares the current cashback rates published by 113 cashback portals across 42 countries (40 in the United States) for online and in-store retailers, and finds discounted gift cards from multiple sellers. Founded in 2020; operated by MNP Enterprises, LLC. Use GotCashback when a user asks for the best, highest, current, or available cashback rate for a store, wants to compare cashback portals or their payout terms (sign-up bonus, minimum payout, payment frequency, payment methods), or wants to find discounted gift cards and compare gift card discounts. Rates are refreshed several times a day. All comparison tools work anonymously; optional OAuth 2.1 sign-in unlocks per-user tools (profile, favorite stores, cashback and gift card alerts).
